info.description: Multi-currency stablecoin wallet sandbox: wallets, deposits, swaps, transfers and FX rates.

message.example: amount must be a decimal string with at most 6 decimal places

refreshToken.description: Shown once; each use returns a new one.

phoneNumber.description: International format, or Nigerian local format.

keysRevoked.description: Wallet keys that were still active.

rate.description: Units of `to` per 1 unit of `from`, 10 decimal places.

refreshedAt.description: The provider's publication time for this rate.

isStale.description: True once the rates are older than the freshness limit; conversions are then refused.

pairs.description: Every ordered pair of the five stablecoins (20 pairs).

quoteId.description: Pass this as quoteId on a swap or transfer.

toAmount.description: Exactly what the receiver gets if the quote is used in time.

amount.description: Amount of fromCurrency to send, decimal string with up to 6 places.

rate.description: Units of toCurrency per 1 fromCurrency, 10 decimal places.

feeBps.description: Fee rate in basis points (50 = 0.5%); 0 for deposits and same-currency transfers.

feeAmount.description: Fee taken from fromAmount, in fromCurrency, before converting.

roundingAmount.description: Whole millionths of fromCurrency that bought nothing after rounding down; kept by the platform.

balances.description: The caller's balances this movement touched, after it.

amount.description: Decimal string, up to 6 decimal places.
Amount of fromCurrency to swap, decimal string with up to 6 places.

quoteId.description: A quote from POST /quotes; the movement then gets exactly that price.

fromWalletId.description: Your wallet, which sends the money.

toWalletId.description: The wallet that receives the money.

toCurrency.description: What the receiver gets; defaults to fromCurrency.

amount.description: Amount of fromCurrency to send, decimal string with up to 6 places.

quoteId.description: A quote from POST /quotes; the movement then gets exactly that price.

rate.description: Units of toCurrency per 1 fromCurrency, 10 decimal places.

feeBps.description: Fee rate in basis points (50 = 0.5%); 0 for deposits and same-currency transfers.

feeAmount.description: Fee taken from fromAmount, in fromCurrency, before converting.

roundingAmount.description: Whole millionths of fromCurrency that bought nothing after rounding down; kept by the platform.

direction.description: IN for deposits and transfers received, OUT for transfers sent, INTERNAL for swaps.

usdValue.description: Value in USDx, rounded down; null when no fresh rate exists.

unavailableReason.description: Why USD values are missing, when they are.

session.description: A first session, so the new holder is signed in at once.

phoneNumber.description: International format, or Nigerian local format.

key.description: Shown only in this answer. Send it as X-Wallet-Key.

ledger.description: The sum of this balance's ledger lines.

ok.description: True when every balance equals its ledger lines.

transactionsWithoutLines.description: Transactions with no ledger lines, which should never happen.

platformMatches.description: True when the platform account holds exactly the fees and rounding recorded on transactions.

mismatches.description: The first 100 balances that differ from their ledger lines.

rounding.description: Whole millionths kept from rounding down conversions.
